name: Bellbound Warden

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The warden makes two Maul attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Concussive Toll.

Actions.name: Maul
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 28 (7d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Concussive Toll
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the warden and has the Prone condition.
Actions.expressedQuote: The target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the warden and has the Prone condition.

Actions.name: Shield Bash
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 14, one creature within 5 feet that the warden can see. *Failure:*  24 (7d6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage only.

Traits.name: Great Weapon Master
Traits.text: When the warden hits a creature with its Maul, the attack deals an extra 3 damage.

lore: Forged from the scrap of shattered temple bells and the breastplates of dead acolytes, this oathbound sentinel exists only to hold its threshold and hear the sanctum fall silent again.

generation.userConcept: a temple warden who fights with a maul
generation.cite: composition after Hill Giant (CR 5) — two of the same swing, thrown rock

monsterDescription: a temple warden who fights with a maul
